description.zh: 傅里叶幅度谱说明有哪些频率却不含先后；加窗与小波让分析同时定位时间与频率。离散教学模型：高斯窗与 Morlet 小波，边界补零。
description.en: A Fourier magnitude spectrum shows which frequencies are present but not their order; windows and wavelets locate frequency in time. Discrete teaching model: Gaussian window and Morlet wavelet with zero padding.

reason.zh: 幅度谱对时间倒放不变，所以无法给出先后；对信号加窗或使用伸缩的小波后，才能同时看到频率和它出现的时刻。
reason.en: The magnitude spectrum is unchanged by time reversal, so it cannot give order; windowing the signal or using a scaled wavelet shows frequency together with when it occurs.

label.en: a spectrogram is a windowed spectrum

reason.zh: 谱图把一串滑动窗口的频谱按时间排成图；窗口越长频率越准、时间越糊。
reason.en: A spectrogram stacks the spectra of a sliding window over time; a longer window gives sharper frequency but blurrier time.
